title: Inventory Management System
description: Production-ready inventory management platform with secure authentication, role-based access control, and analytics dashboard. Built REST APIs using Node.js and Prisma with PostgreSQL for scalable data handling and validation.

title: QuestNote
description: Full-stack AI-powered note-taking platform enabling semantic search and conversational Q&A over user notes. Designed vector embedding pipeline using OpenAI API and ChromaDB for context-aware retrieval with persistent chat history.
